status: retrospective protocol freeze before final reported model collection
scope: Hydrogen-station process physics and SAGA-PY decision-support validation

process_physics.dataset: Powertech Labs SAE J2601 Tables Method laboratory data
process_physics.tank_submodel_split: laboratory test number modulo 3 equals 0 is validation; all other eligible tests are calibration
process_physics.experimental_quality_screen: 0.8 <= integrated measured mass / nominal SOC-implied mass change <= 1.2
process_physics.quality_screen_sensitivity: repeat the calibration with all 36 tests retained
secondary_endpoints: final SOC error in percentage points
process_physics.uncertainty: case-level nonparametric percentile bootstrap of each mean, 10000 replicates
process_physics.closed_loop_role: uncalibrated diagnostic baseline; controller and dispenser claims require acceptable external agreement

closed_loop_flow_area_calibration.reason: The uncalibrated closed loop failed all engineering screens after the tank-only analysis was frozen.
closed_loop_flow_area_calibration.exploratory_case_removed_from_confirmati: H2P-L06 was inspected at flow-area multipliers 1.25 and 1.5 and is development evidence only.
closed_loop_flow_area_calibration.selection_objective: mean of squared normalized pressure RMSE/5 MPa, temperature RMSE/10 degC, and SOC RMSE/5 percentage points
closed_loop_flow_area_calibration.rule: Select one multiplier on the listed development cases and freeze it before evaluating the listed comparison cases.
closed_loop_flow_area_calibration.deviation: The listed comparison cases were inspected before and rerun after a controller anti-windup correction. They are internal iteration evidence, not a pristine untouched external holdout. No further tuning against them is permitted.
closed_loop_flow_area_calibration.observed_result: The selected multiplier was 1.25. The first internal comparison failed all 11 engineering screens; mean pressure, temperature and SOC RMSE were 11.842 MPa, 10.292 degC and 15.347 percentage points.

structural_correction_result.changes: Corrected flow-limit anti-windup, temperature-class-aware precooler trip threshold, monotonic per-dispenser cascade dispatch, and line-pack continuity across bank switches. No parameter was refitted.
structural_correction_result.development_result: 0/8 passed; mean pressure, temperature and SOC RMSE were 13.695 MPa, 21.634 degC and 17.668 percentage points.
structural_correction_result.internal_confirmation_result: 0/11 passed; mean pressure, temperature and SOC RMSE were 7.213 MPa, 9.179 degC and 10.112 percentage points.
structural_correction_result.interpretation: The structural correction materially improved the already-inspected comparison set but did not satisfy the predeclared screen. It remains internal iteration evidence and cannot be described as an untouched external holdout.

decision_support.dataset: JRC HIAD 2.2 HRS events with a response, lesson, or corrective field
decision_support.split: deterministic consequence-stratified 25 percent development / 75 percent holdout split using SHA-256 ordering
decision_support.holdout_access: a non-rating coordinator reviews every frozen vignette; validate exact case retention, immutable references and model-visible edits; SHA-256 lock the approved casebook before collecting model responses
variants: direct one-pass LLM response with the historical observation
SAGA standards-document RAG response with the same observation
decision_support.sampling: three SAGA responses per event under a frozen provider/model configuration
decision_support.failed_call_rule: retain every failed provider call as a masked failure response for blinded scoring; do not silently retry or exclude it
decision_support.primary_endpoint: paired event-level difference in mean seven-criterion expert composite score
decision_support.reviewers: three independent qualified hydrogen/process-safety reviewers, blinded to allocation; one complete locked file per coded reviewer
decision_support.human_participant_governance: record the applicable institutional approval, exemption, or not-required determination before recruiting reviewers or collecting ratings
decision_support.integrity_checks: hash-locked casebook, allocation and blank form; reject incomplete forms, changed response text, duplicate codes, invalid scores, and unexplained binary safety marks
decision_support.inference: case-level bootstrap 95 percent CI and paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test

consequence_physics.dataset: USN/FFI open-ended rectangular-channel hydrogen dispersion experiments
consequence_physics.status: normalization complete; no direct production-model validation claim before explicit release and sensor geometry mapping
consequence_physics.prohibited_claim: channel measurements alone validate outdoor station consequence distances

claim_rule: Unit tests demonstrate implementation consistency only. Physical, decision-support, field-safety, and regulatory claims require their stated external evidence.
